2293335.name: Chabad Pelham
2293335.note: COLlive, 28 July 2013 ('New Shluchim to Westchester, NY'): 'In honor of Chof Menachem Av, Rabbi Levi and Chayale Groner were appointed as the new Chabad Shluchim in Pelham, an affluent suburban town in Westchester County, New York.' Its chabad.org listing went up 28 Oct 2013.

4444340.name: CTeen Upper West Side
4444340.note: COLlive, 5 Sept 2019 ('New Shluchim to Manhattan's Upper West Side'): 'Rabbi Eliyahu and Shayna Sapochkinsky, with their son Mendel, have recently moved on Shlichus to the Upper West Side of Manhattan', appointed by Rabbi Shlomo Kugel of Chabad of the West Side; 'Eliyahu and Shayna have extensive experience teaching and working with teens'. Its chabad.org listing went up 14 Nov 2019.

3211203.name: Chabad of Brooklyn Law School
3211203.note: COLlive, 30 Aug 2016 ('New Shluchim to Brooklyn Law'): 'Chabad on Campus is proud to announce the opening of a new Chabad House serving Jewish students at Brooklyn Law School. Beginning this fall semester, Rabbi Eliyahu and Shaindy Raskin (nee Holtzberg) have opened their home to Jewish students'. Its chabad.org listing went up 29 Mar 2016.

2613667.name: Chabad of Huntington Village
2613667.note: No founding year found yet. Its chabad.org listing went up 2014-06-23, so it existed by then. COLlive, 22 Dec 2015 ('New Shluchim to Long Island', https://collive.com/new-shluchim-to-long-island-1/): Rabbi Yaakov Yosef and Chaya Raskin 'have recently moved with their 2 children to Huntington Village'; 'Since their move a few months ago ... The Raskins have hosted the area's first High holiday services'; appointed by Rabbi and Mrs. Asher Vaisfiche of the Melville Chabad Center. That is more than a year after the listing, so the year is left open. Director: Yaakov Yosef Raskin.
